```{r stroomsnelheid en diepte}

GDB.path <- "Q:/Projects/PRJ_Schelde/Ecotide/Vissen/PRJ_Reservegebieden/Data/Data_INBO/Dwarsraaien_PRJ_Reservegebieden.gdb"
Layer.name <- "dwarspunten_extract"

# Read spatial data and drop the geometry column
Data.dwarspunten.sf <- st_read(dsn = GDB.path, layer = Layer.name)
Data.dwarspunten <- Data.dwarspunten.sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  bind_cols(as.data.frame(st_coordinates(Data.dwarspunten.sf)))
  
Data.dwarspunten <- Data.dwarspunten %>% 
  # truucje om QN data bij de data te betrekken; deze moeten nog aangeleverd worden door UA
  mutate(avg_v_flood_QN = avg_v_flood, 
         avg_v_ebb_QN = avg_v_ebb, 
         max_v_flood_QN = max_v_flood, 
         max_v_ebb_QN = max_v_ebb)

table(Data.dwarspunten$Omes)

Data.dwarspunten <- Data.dwarspunten %>%
  filter(!is.na(diepte),
         diepte > 0,
         # de bedoeling is om hier ook nog de Rupel bij te betrekken
         Omes %in% c(9:19, "Ringvaart", "TijarmZw")) %>% 
  mutate(afstand_vlissingen = case_when(Omes %in% c("Ringvaart", "TijarmZw") ~ AfstMonding + 165.3, 
                                       .default = AfstMonding)) %>% 
  # er sukkelden nog enkele punten in stroomopwaarts van zijriviermondingen, 
  # met kleine afstand tot de monding, vandaar de volgende filter
  filter(afstand_vlissingen > 64)

table(Data.dwarspunten$Omes)
table(Data.dwarspunten$Segment)

Data.dwarspunten <- Data.dwarspunten %>%
  rename(avg_vel_eb = avg_v_ebb_QN,
         avg_vel_vl = avg_v_flood_QN,
         max_vel_eb = max_v_ebb_QN,
         max_vel_vl = max_v_flood_QN,
         depth = diepte) %>% 
  mutate(max_vel = pmax(max_vel_eb, max_vel_vl, na.rm = TRUE),
         avg_vel = rowMeans(.[c("avg_vel_eb", "avg_vel_vl")], na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(Segment, AfstMonding)

summary(Data.dwarspunten)

Data.dwarspunten <- Data.dwarspunten %>% 
  drop_na(avg_v_ebb, avg_v_flood, max_v_ebb, max_v_flood)

```


```{r retentie en ecosysteem data}

Data.UA <- read_delim(paste0("../../../Data/Data_processed/data_UA_", Alternatief.scenario, "_maand_IP_TEMP.csv"), delim = ";")
summary(Data.UA)

# problemen met de UA data voor mei 2048 voor box 1 tem 23 voor residence time en retentie:
view(Data.UA %>% filter(ym(paste0(year, month)) == "2048/05/01"))
Data.UA.agg <- 
  Data.UA %>%  
  rename(jaar = year, 
				 maand = month,
				 segment = Naam,
				 afstand_monding = AfstMondingCentroide) %>%
  group_by(box, segment, afstand_monding, OMES, SalZone, KRWzone, jaar) %>% 
	summarise(salinity_A = mean(Salinity[maand %in% c(5)], na.rm=TRUE),
						salinity = mean(Salinity[maand %in% c(5,6)], na.rm=TRUE),
						temp_A = mean(Temperatuur[maand %in% c(5)], na.rm=TRUE),
						temp = mean(Temperatuur[maand %in% c(5,6)], na.rm=TRUE),
						oxygen_A = min(Oxygen[maand %in% c(5)], na.rm=TRUE)*31.999, # Moleculair gewicht O2  : 31.999 g/mol
						oxygen = min(Oxygen[maand %in% c(5,6)], na.rm=TRUE)*31.999, # Moleculair gewicht O2  : 31.999 g/mol
						spm_surface = mean(SPM[maand %in% c(5,6)], na.rm=TRUE),
						zoo_C = mean(ZooC[maand %in% c(5,6)], na.rm=TRUE)*12.0107,# Moleculair gewicht C  : 12.0107 g/mol
						retentie = mean(Retentie[maand == 5], na.rm=TRUE), # dag/km
						verplaatsing = mean(Verplaatsing[maand == 5], na.rm=TRUE)) %>% # km/dag
  mutate(afstand_vlissingen = case_when(OMES %in% c("TijarmZw", "Ringvaart") ~ afstand_monding + 165.3, 
                                       .default = afstand_monding)) %>% 
  ungroup()
	
summary(Data.UA.agg)
Data.UA.agg %>% filter(retentie %in% c(Inf, -Inf)) %>% nrow()
# retentie -Inf & Inf in 31 rijen

```


```{r interpolatie retentie en ecosysteem data}

##### lineare interpolatie UA data
### !! opgelet, deze werkwijze zal niet voldoen indien de Rupel wordt 'aangetakt' in de analyse !!
int.O <- NULL
for(j in unique(Data.UA.agg$jaar)) {
    S <- subset(Data.UA.agg, jaar==j) 
    D <- data.frame(jaar = j, afstand_vlissingen = unique(Data.dwarspunten$afstand_vlissingen)) 
    for(v in c("salinity_A","salinity","oxygen_A","oxygen","temp_A","temp","spm_surface","zoo_C", "retentie", "verplaatsing")) {
      if(any(!is.na(S[,v]))) {
        lin <- approx(x=S$afstand_vlissingen, y=pull(S,v), xout=D$afstand_vlissingen)
      } else {
        lin <- data.frame(x=D$afstand_vlissingen, y=NA)
      }
      D[,paste(v,"linear",sep="_")] <- lin$y
    }
    int.O <- rbind(int.O, D)
}

rm(D, S, lin)
##### toevoegen SPM dieptegemiddeld
# [ zie p10 fint-rapport voor uitleg onderstaande bewerking ]
int.O$spm_depth_avg_linear <-  int.O$spm_surface_linear*(4.1-0.02*int.O$afstand_vlissingen)

summary(int.O)

int.O %>% filter(is.na(salinity_A_linear)) %>% distinct(afstand_vlissingen) %>% pull()
# tijarm Zwijnaarde (max afstand aslijn > data UA)

int.O <- int.O %>% drop_na(salinity_A_linear)
summary(int.O)
sum(is.na(int.O))
# enkel nog 385 NA-waarden voor retentie-lineair -> uitzoeken!
int.O %>% filter(retentie_linear %in% c(Inf, -Inf)) %>% nrow()
# 198 rijen met Inf
```


```{r samenvoegen data}

Data.UA.dwarspunten <- merge(Data.dwarspunten[c("SalZone","Omes","afstand_vlissingen",
                                        "max_vel_vl","max_vel_eb","avg_vel_vl","avg_vel_eb","max_vel","avg_vel",
                                        "depth","X","Y")], 
                                 int.O) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), NaN, .x)))

summary(Data.UA.dwarspunten)
# 336375 records; 4315 NA-waarden voor retentie_linear

```


```{r berekening 1D}

# hier worden de gegevens per dwarsraai geaggregeerd
Data.UA.dwarspunten.1D <- 
  Data.UA.dwarspunten %>% 
	group_by(afstand_vlissingen, Omes, jaar) %>% 
	summarise(X = X[depth==max(depth, na.rm=TRUE)][1],
						Y = Y[depth==max(depth, na.rm=TRUE)][1],
						avg_vel_eb.max = max(avg_vel_eb, na.rm=TRUE),
						avg_vel_vl.max = max(avg_vel_vl, na.rm=TRUE),
						max_vel_vl.max = max(max_vel_vl, na.rm=TRUE),
						max_vel_eb.max = max(max_vel_eb, na.rm=TRUE),
						avg_vel_eb = mean(avg_vel_eb, na.rm=TRUE),
						avg_vel_vl = mean(avg_vel_vl, na.rm=TRUE),
						max_vel_vl = mean(max_vel_vl, na.rm=TRUE),
						max_vel_eb = mean(max_vel_eb, na.rm=TRUE),
						avg_vel = mean(avg_vel, na.rm=TRUE),
						max_vel.max = max(max_vel, na.rm=TRUE),
						max_vel = mean(max_vel, na.rm=TRUE),
						depth.max = max(depth, na.rm=TRUE),
						depth = mean(depth, na.rm=TRUE),
						salinity_A_linear = mean(salinity_A_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						salinity_linear = mean(salinity_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						oxygen_A_linear = mean(oxygen_A_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						oxygen_linear = mean(oxygen_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						temp_A_linear = mean(temp_A_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						temp_linear = mean(temp_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						spm_surface_linear = mean(spm_surface_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						spm_depth_avg_linear = mean(spm_depth_avg_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						zoo_C_linear = mean(zoo_C_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						retentie_linear = mean(retentie_linear, na.rm=TRUE),
						verplaatsing_linear = mean(verplaatsing_linear, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
	ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), NaN, .x)))

```


```{r figuren}

vrs <- c("max_vel", "avg_vel", "depth", "salinity_A_linear", "salinity_linear", "oxygen_A_linear", "oxygen_linear", "temp_A_linear", "temp_linear", "spm_surface_linear", "spm_depth_avg_linear", "zoo_C_linear", "retentie_linear", "verplaatsing_linear")

nms <- c("max_vel", "avg_vel", "depth", "salinity_A_linear", "salinity (ppm)", "oxygen_A_linear", "oxygen (mg/l)", "temp_A_linear", "temperature (°C)", "Surface SPM (mg/l)", "spm_depthAvg_linear", "Zooplankton (mgC/l)", "Retentie (d/km)", "Verplaatsing (km/d)")


for (v in 1:length(vrs)) {
  {Data.UA.dwarspunten.1D %>% 
      mutate(jaar = factor(jaar)) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(afstand_vlissingen, .data[[vrs[v]]])) +
      geom_line(aes(color = jaar)) +
      geom_text(data=Afst.sal, aes(x=afstand_monding, y=min(Data.UA.dwarspunten.1D[[vrs[v]]], na.rm = TRUE), label=locatie), 
                angle=90, nudge_x = -3, hjust="left") +
      geom_vline(data = Afst.sal, aes(xintercept = afstand_monding), linetype = 3, color = "grey25") +
      labs(title = str_c(Alternatief, Scenario, sep = "  "),
           x = "Distance to border BE-NL (km)",
           y = nms[v])} %>% 
    print()
}

```
